    """Comprehensive text preprocessing for clean TF-IDF features"""
    if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]", "", text)
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = text.strip()
    return text
